name: 1337 H@Xx0R
text: Your gobbing is renowned across the galaxy's infospheres, making you something of an urban legend. You gain the skill feat. Hackers and frequent infosphere users against whom you succeed at a or Combat Hack check recognize your handiwork, granting you a +1 status bonus to Deception checks to , [[/act create-a-diversion]], or those creatures for 1 minute.

name: 360 No Scope
text: Requirements You're wielding a gun. You fire a trick shot as part of a daredevil maneuver. You Parkour. You can Aim and then make a ranged Strike with the gun you're wielding during this movement, including when you're falling.

Requirements You're wielding a gun.

You fire a trick shot as part of a daredevil maneuver. You . You can and then make a ranged Strike with the gun you're wielding during this movement, including when you're falling.

name: A Different Sort of Fey
text: Radiation and electricity are simply natural phenomena, which might explain your fey-like connection to things others see as science. You can cast , , and once per day each as 3rd-rank primal innate spells.

name: A Life For a Life
text:
You've learned to manipulate the forces of vitality and void to cheat death. Choose one of the following cantrips: Forbidding Ward or Stabilize. You can cast this spell as a divine innate spell at will. A cantrip is heightened to a spell rank equal to half your level rounded up.
Special You can select this feat twice. Each time, you must select a different cantrip.

name: A Little Piece of Home
text: Your affinity with the plant life of Kasath has made it so that you can summon it from nearly anywhere. You gain Verdant Code as a 2nd-rank arcane innate spell you can cast once per hour. You gain a +2 status bonus to your basic Reflex saves to avoid the piercing damage from your verdant code .

name: AbadarCorp Rep Dedication
text:
You've internalized your corporation's culture and strategies, and you're knowledgeable about general business practices. You gain the Additional Lore general feat for Business or Corporate Lore.

You can use Business or Corporate Lore instead of any other skill when making a Recall Knowledge check about subjects related to your work, such as goods your company buys and sells, individuals or settlements where you do business, or industry laws.

AbadarCorp Rep

name: Aberrant Shape
text: You can take the form of a terrifying aberration. When you Change Shape, you can choose one of the following: gain the effects of a 4th-rank enlarge spell and 6th-rank eldritch bond spell; gain the effects of a 2nd-rank enlarge spell and 6th-rank eldritch bond spell granting three abilities; or gain the effects of a 6th-rank eldritch bond spell granting four abilities. This effect lasts for 1 minute or until you shift back, whichever comes first.

name: Able Assistant
text: You're always prepared to help others succeed in their callings. You gain a +4 circumstance bonus on checks to Aid.

name: Above and Below
text: You and your partner outmaneuver your foes by taking advantage of your difference in size. When you and your ally who's a different size than you flank the same enemy, that enemy takes a –2 circumstance penalty to its DCs against [[/act disarm]], [[/act feint]], [[/act reposition]], [[/act shove]], [[/act trip]], and [[/act tumble-through]] attempts.

name: Absolute Empathy
text: You find the feelings of your foe to better understand them. You attempt to [[/act feint skill=diplomacy]] against a creature. Unlike a normal Feint, use Diplomacy instead of Deception. You attempt your check against the creature's Will DC instead of its Perception DC.

name: Absolute Unit
text: Your size gives the impression that there's no room to escape. You gain the Intimidating Glare skill feat. Additionally, if you're blocking a target's passage down a hallway or door, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your Intimidation checks when you [[/act demoralize]] that target.

name: Absorb Flame
text: Trigger You would take fire damage. You incorporate fire that washes over you into your own flame, burning brighter and hotter for a short time. Until the beginning of your next turn, the area of your solar luminance is doubled, and your next Strike deals additional fire damage equal to half your level (rounded up).

name: Absorb Magic
text: Frequency once per hour Trigger You attempt a saving throw against an area effect with the arcane trait. You attempt to absorb some of the magic of an incoming spell into your blood. Attempt a counteract check against the triggering effect; your counteract rank equals half your level (rounded up), and for the counteract check, use the higher of your spell attack modifier or your class DC minus 10. If you counteract the triggering effect, you end the effect for all other creatures in the area, but you become Drained 1 for 10 minutes as your body struggles to contain the transfusion of magic.

name: Absorb Vibe
text: Frequency once per 10 minutes By touching a friend and concentrating, you can draw in harmful effects negatively impacting their emotions. Attempt a perception{Counteract} check using your Perception modifier and a counteract rank equal to half your level (rounded up). If you succeed, the target gains temporary Hit Points equal to your level for a number of rounds equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum 1 round).

name: Absorbent Plating
text: Some threats go beyond the physical, and your chitin can adapt to protect you from them. You gain resistance to acid, cold, electricity, fire, or sonic damage equal to half your level. Special You can take this feat multiple times. Each time you do so, select a different damage type.

name: Accelerated Mind
text: Your synthetic brain makes it difficult for your enemies to assault your mind while ensuring that your thought processing is as fast as the currents flowing through your circuits. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against mental effects.

name: Accelerated Step
text: You can absorb the solar and electromagnetic radiation in your surroundings, transforming it into kinetic energy that propels your body faster. Your Speeds increase by 5 feet. In addition, you gain the Light Speed action.

name: According to My Calculations
text:
You announce business projections to an ally to benefit them. Make a or check against a DC based on your level. Whether or not you're successful, the target becomes temporarily immune to According to My Calculations for 24 hours. The benefit lasts for 1 minute or until activated.
Critical Success The target gains a +2 circumstance bonus on their next skill check or attack roll.

Success The target gains a +1 circumstance bonus on their next skill check or attack roll.

Critical Failure The target takes a –1 penalty to their next skill check or attack roll.

name: Acidic Spit
text: Frequency once per day You have a specialized gland that produces an acidic compound that eats away at hard surfaces. You spit this acidic compound in a . Each creature in the line takes |options:area-damage] damage with a type save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC. A creature that fails its save gains weakness 5 to piercing damage until the end of your next turn (this has no effect on creatures with resistance or immunity to piercing damage). At 16th level, the damage increases to 11d6.

name: Acquire Asset
text: You assess a foe while in the thick of battle by observing their reactions to your attack. Make a melee or ranged Strike against a creature that isn't your asset. On a hit, your target becomes your asset as if you'd used Size Up. On a critical hit, you can also immediately attempt a check to Recall Knowledge about the target.

name: Acquire Asset
text: You assess a foe while in the thick of battle by observing their reactions to your attack. Make a melee or ranged Strike against a creature that isn't your asset. On a hit, your target becomes your asset as if you'd used . On a critical hit, you can also immediately attempt a check to about the target.

name: Acrobatic Maneuvers
text: You've trained in exotic acrobatic techniques. You gain a +2 bonus to combat maneuver checks using Acrobatics, and you can substitute Acrobatics for Athletics for climb and swim checks.

name: Activate All Brains!
text: Frequency once per day You put all your brains in a hyperactive state to process dangers. You become Quickened for 1 minute and can use your extra action only to Recall Knowledge, Stride, or Strike.

name: Activate Sensilla
text: Requirements You're standing on a solid surface. You listen for vibrations through your legs' sensitive hairlike fibers. You gain imprecise tremorsense with a range of 20 feet until the start of your next turn.

name: Activate Targeting System
text: One action (flourish): the next time before end of turn that you, your drone, or your turret makes an attack roll, the attack ignores circumstance penalties and any flat check from the target being concealed or hidden.

name: Adapt to Injury
text: Frequency once per day Trigger You're struck by a critical hit that deals physical damage. Your body's polyps respond to an injury by immediately shedding wounded or dead polyps and regrowing new ones. Attempt a flat. If you're successful, the attack becomes a normal hit.

name: Adaptable Intellect
text: Requirements You have access to an infosphere, library, or similar reference collection. What might take other minds a lifetime to master, you can temporarily absorb through a brief, intense study session. During your daily preparations, you can review literature to gain the trained proficiency rank in one skill of your choice. This proficiency lasts until you prepare again. Since this proficiency is temporary, you can't use it as a prerequisite for a skill increase or a permanent character option (like a feat).

name: Adaptable Limbs
text: You grow sturdy lower limbs that allow you to walk on land. Increase your Speed to 20 feet. Additionally, you gain the Adaptive Locomotion action.

name: Adaptable Membranes
text: Your body instinctively integrates foreign materials. You gain the general feat. If the chosen augmentation deals damage, increase that damage by 1 for every two augmentations you have (minimum 1). If the chosen augmentation gives you resistance to damage or has Hardness, increase it by 1 for every two augmentations you have (minimum 1).

name: Adapted Augmentations
text: You embrace ultimate adaptation by integrating cutting-edge augmentations into your body. Choose one common augmentation with an item level of 1 or less. You begin with this augmentation already installed in your body (you don't need to pay the credits to purchase this starting augmentation). This augmentation doesn't count toward your implant limit.

name: Adapted Underwater Brawler
text: You've learned how to wield nearly any weapon effectively while underwater. You don't take the –2 penalty for making melee slashing or bludgeoning Strikes while underwater. Your ranged attacks aren't affected by being underwater. You can use weapons that deal fire damage underwater.

name: Adaptive Camouflage
text: You gain the Adaptive Camouflage mod (armor): using auto-populating holograms, the creature wearing the modded armor doesn't need cover or concealment to Hide or Sneak.

name: Adaptive Coagulation
text: Frequency once per day You can coagulate your oozy body to respond to different types of ongoing harm. Attempt a flat; on a success, you recover from any ongoing persistent damage. Additionally, you gain resistance to each type of persistent damage you had when you used Adaptive Coagulation equal to half your level for 1 minute.

name: Adaptive Defense
text: You prepare your vitality network to catch some of your excess magic, allowing it to flow back and bolster your bond's defenses. If the next action you use is to Cast a Spell that deals damage, whether or not it successfully deals damage, you and one bonded ally gain resistance to that spell's type of damage equal to the spell's rank (minimum 1) until the end of your next turn. If the spell deals more than one type of damage, choose one and gain resistance to that type.

name: Adaptive Defense
text: You prepare your vitality network to catch some of your excess magic, allowing it to flow back and bolster your bond's defenses. If the next action you use is to Cast a Spell that deals damage, whether or not it successfully deals damage, you and one bonded ally gain resistance to that spell's type of damage equal to the spell's rank (minimum 1) until the end of your next turn. If the spell deals more than one type of damage, choose one and gain resistance to that type.

name: Adaptive Dermis
text: Frequency once per hour Trigger You take acid, cold, electricity, fire, poison, sonic, or void damage. You've recently developed a new mutation: flesh that rapidly adapts to hazardous environments—for a time. You gain resistance 5 against the triggering damage type for 1 hour.

name: Adaptive Echolocation
text: You can emit sound waves and sense your environment as it's reflected by objects around you. When you take the [[/act seek]] action, you can use hearing as a precise sense with a range of 40 feet until the start of your next turn. You can also use this sense while you Search.

name: Adaptive Resistance
text: Frequency once every 10 minutes Requirements Your last action was a successful tentacle Strike against a living creature. You absorb fragments of the genetic code and psychic energy of living creatures through your tentacles to temporarily augment your abilities. Pick one damage type that your target is resistant or immune to. You gain resistance to that damage type equal to half your level for 1 minute. If the creature has a compound resistance or immunity, pick one damage type; for example, if a creature is resistant to all physical damage, you could pick bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing. If you don't know the target's resistances or immunities, you gain a resistance chosen at random. If the target has no immunities or resistances, you gain no resistance, and this use doesn't count against Adaptive Resistance's frequency.

name: Adaptive Talent
text:
You gain the Adaptive Talent class feature, but you do not gain additional skill feats at higher levels.
Special You can select this feat a second time as a 10th level feat and a 16th level feat, increasing the number of skill feats you gain using adaptive talent by 1.

name: Adat Training
text: You have studied the art of adat—the kasathan mystical technique of preserving a slice of brain from a deceased intelligent creature and establishing a technomagical link to the creature's soul. The kasathan Doyenate use these to preserve the wisdom of their ancestors, and you've adapted their technique for use in the field to draw important information out of a target or send disorienting messages to a target's mind. You gain Holographic Memory and Void Whispers as 3rd-rank divine innate spells. You can cast each spell once per day, and when you cast holographic memory , you can extract a memory of up to 10 minutes instead of 5 minutes.

name: Additional Lore
text: Your broad experience covers an additional area of expertise. Choose an additional Lore skill subcategory; you become trained in that Lore skill.

name: Additional Unarmed Attack
text:
You've directed magic through a part of your body, honing it into a powerful unarmed attack. You gain that additional attack as an unarmed attack in the brawling weapon group. Choose one of the additional attacks available to your heritage.

• A horn unarmed attack deals 1d4 piercing damage and has the deadly d6 and finesse traits.

• A tail unarmed attack deals 1d4 bludgeoning damage and has the finesse, sweep and trip traits.

• A wing unarmed attack deals 1d4 bludgeoning damage and has the backswing, finesse, and shove traits.

Special You can gain this feat multiple times if your heritage has more than one potential additional unarmed attack, choosing a different unarmed attack each time you do.

name: Adhering Acid
text: You mix your sticky, corrosive resin with certain weapons and spells. The next time this turn you Strike with a spell or weapon, one creature that takes non-persistent acid damage from the Strike becomes Clumsy 1 until the start of your next turn, then becomes immune to Adhering Acid for 24 hours.

name: Adhesive Grip
text: Your sticky mucous lets you hang onto foes with a painfully tenacious grip. When you roll a critical failure on a check to [[/act grapple]] a target, you get a failure instead. In addition, when a creature you've Grabbed rolls a failure on its check to Escape, it gets a critical failure instead, and if it rolls a critical success, it gets a success instead.

name: Adjust Gravity
text: Your connection to the gravitational forces of copi allows you to temporarily alter gravity's effects on your body. You treat gravity as being one step higher or lower (for example, low gravity becomes standard gravity, or standard gravity becomes high gravity), but you can't Adjust Gravity to extreme or zero gravity. This only affects you, your gear, and your movement. This lasts until the end of your next turn if you adjust from extreme or zero gravity; otherwise, it lasts 1 hour, until you Adjust Gravity again, or until you enter an environment with a different gravity, whichever comes first. At 13th level, you can adjust gravity to zero gravity or extreme gravity. At 17th level, you can lower or raise the gravity level by up to two steps.

name: Admixture Breath
text: Your internal chemical balance is adaptable, allowing you to control the composition of your normally flaming expulsions. When you use Fire Breath, you can choose to deal acid or cold damage instead of fire damage. Special If you're a mystic with the elemental connection, you can also choose bludgeoning, electricity, or poison damage instead of fire damage.

name: Adopted Ancestry
text: You're fully immersed in another ancestry's culture and traditions, whether born into them, earned through rite of passage, or bonded through a deep friendship or romance. Choose a common ancestry or another ancestry to which you have access. You can select ancestry feats from the ancestry you chose, in addition to your character's own ancestry, as long as the ancestry feats don't require any physiological feature that you lack, as determined by the GM.

name: Adopted Overlords
text: Your ancestors served the Veskarium for countless generations. You've incorporated vesk traditions into your own life, and the Veskarium has freely shared its secrets with you. You gain the Adopted Ancestry general feat and must choose vesk. You gain a 1st-level Vesk ancestry feat for which you qualify, and your mantle grows tougher. Increase your resistance to precision damage by 2.

name: Adopted Talents
text: Requirements You have a bonded partner. Since becoming bonded with your partner, you've learned a lot about them, and you're beginning to pick up their habits, interests, and knowledge. You gain the Adopted Ancestry, but you must select the ancestry of your bonded partner. You also gain one 1st-level ancestry feat from the ancestry you chose for Adopted Ancestry. Special You must have a permanent partner bond to select this feat, meaning you can't be a mercurial dragonkin.

name: Adorable Face
text: Your big-eyed, pleading look melts hard hearts. You gain your choice of the Charming Liar or Hobnobber skill feats, even if you don't meet the feat's prerequisites. Additionally, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to initiative rolls when you use Deception or Diplomacy for initiative.

name: Adrenaline Rush
text: Frequency: once per hour Trigger: You roll initiative. Danger gives you a rush. For 1 minute, you ignore the encumbered condition and gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your Athletics checks. While you are not encumbered, you gain a +5-foot circumstance bonus to your Speed for the duration.

name: Advance Atmospheric Flight
text: You've become more adept at using your energy wings within an atmosphere.

name: Advanced Atmospheric Flight
text: You've become more adept at using your energy wings within an atmosphere. no longer has a frequency and can be used as often as desired. When you use Atmospheric Flight, your wings remain manifested until you spend a single action to purposefully dismiss them.

name: Advanced Cross Platform Application

meta.Prerequisites: ["Advanced Magic Hack","Cross Platform Application","Greater Magic Hack"]

text: You learn the advanced magic hack of the same programming language as the magic hack you learned with Cross Platform Application.

name: Advanced Customization
text: Your drone gains one advanced customization, granting it a new ability. Special: you can select this feat up to three times.

name: Advanced Design Specialization
text: You're able to unlock dormant abilities in your design. Choose an android heritage. You gain all of its mechanical effects. You count as having that heritage for the purposes of qualifying for feats.

name: Advanced Distortion
text:
You gain one witchwarper feat. For the purpose of meeting its prerequisites, your witchwarper level is half your character level.
Special You can select this feat more than once. Each time you do, you gain another witchwarper feat.

name: Advanced Drone
text: You further customize your drone; it becomes an advanced companion. (Continues the Tactical Drone → Refined Chassis → Advanced Drone chassis chain.)

name: Advanced Epiphany
text: You gain a deeper understanding of your connection. You gain the advanced epiphany spell for your chosen connection.

name: Advanced Epiphany
text: You gain a deeper understanding of your connection. You gain the advanced epiphany spell for your chosen connection.

name: Advanced First Aid
text: You use your medical training to ameliorate sickness or assuage fears. When you use Medicine to Administer First Aid, instead of Stabilizing a character or Stopping Bleeding, you can reduce an ally's Frightened or Sickened condition by 2, or remove either of those conditions entirely on a critical success. You can remove only one condition at a time. The DC for the Medicine check is usually the DC of the effect that caused the condition.

name: Advanced Gunner
text:
You gain one operative feat. For the purpose of meeting its prerequisites, your operative level is half your character level.
Special You can select this feat more than once. Each time you do, you gain another operative feat.

name: Advanced Leadership
text:
You gain one envoy feat. For the purpose of meeting its prerequisites, your envoy level is equal to half your character level.
Special You can select this feat more than once. Each time you select it, you gain another envoy feat.

name: Advanced Magic Hack
text: You learn the advanced magic hack of your chosen programming language.

name: Advanced Mysticism
text:
You gain one mystic feat. For the purpose of meeting its prerequisites, your mystic level is half your character level.
Special You can select this feat more than once. Each time you do, you gain another mystic feat.

name: Advanced Physiological Mimicry
text: You more closely mimic the physiological traits of your ancestry. You gain a heritage from your ancestry in addition to this versatile heritage. If an ability from this new heritage conflicts with an ability from your versatile heritage, you choose which of the conflicting abilities your character has, as normal. You count as having that heritage for the purposes of qualifying for feats.

name: Advanced Soldier Training
text:
You gain one soldier feat. For the purpose of meeting its prerequisites, your soldier level is half your character level.
Special You can select this feat more than once. Each time you do, you gain another soldier feat.

name: Advanced Stellar Attunement
text:
You gain one solarian feat. For the purpose of meeting its prerequisites, your solarian level is half your character level.
Special You can select this feat more than once. Each time you do, you gain another solarian feat.

name: Advanced Targeting System
text: Once per 10 minutes, when you roll an attack roll affected by Activate Targeting System, you can add the fortune trait to that roll, rolling twice and using the higher result.

name: Advanced Targeting System
text: Your ocular processors are augmented with advanced targeting systems, allowing you to more easily pinpoint your enemy and predict their movements.

name: Advanced Warp
text: Your paradox begins to cement itself across your life. You gain the advanced warp spell for your paradox.

name: Advanced Warp
text: Your paradox begins to cement itself across your life. You gain the advanced warp spell for your paradox.

name: Advantageous Assault
text: When your foe is weak, you press on. When you successfully Strike a creature that has the frightened or persistent bleed condition with a melee or ranged weapon, you gain a circumstance bonus to the damage roll equal to the number of weapon damage dice of the weapon used for the Strike.

name: Aerial Dash
text: Whether by catching a current or pushing yourself beyond your limits, you fly forward incredibly fast. Fly up to three times. If you are a stormrider dragonkin, instead you Fly up to four times.

name: Aerial Master
text: Your ability to fly through the skies under your own power is unparalleled. Your fly Speed increases by 10 feet.

name: Aeternal Stride
text:
Frequency once per day

Using a vestige of the lux aeterna ritual, you tap into your future potential, allowing you to move in the blink of an eye. You gain two actions, which you can use to Leap, Stand, Step, or Stride. If you have an appropriate Speed, you can add Burrow, Climb, Fly, or Swim to this list. The movement happens so quickly, all that anyone else sees is a blur, and they can't act while you are moving, even to take free actions or reactions that would normally be triggered by your movement.

name: Agglomerate Leshy
text: You gather organic plant or fungal matter to your body, permanently increasing your size. You become Large. Once per day as a two-action activity with the concentrate trait, you can grow a burst of foliage that further reinforces your body, increasing your reach by 5 feet, granting you a +2 status bonus to melee damage rolls, and making you Clumsy 1 for 10 minutes.

name: Aggressive Antlers
text: Like copaxi warriors of old, you've grown particularly sturdy and threatening copi antlers instead of the elegant ones favored by most modern copaxis. You gain an antlers unarmed attack that deals ] damage. Your antlers are in the brawling group and have the finesse and unarmed traits.

name: Aggressively Ostentatious
text: Your photonic magic is flashy and disorienting to behold. When a creature fails or critically fails a save against a spell you cast that has the light trait, they also become for 1 round.

name: Akashic Sync
text: Frequency once per 10 minutes You can briefly connect to the Akashic Records. You Recall Knowledge using Occultism instead of any other skill as though Occultism were applicable to perform Recall Knowledge for that topic. Critical Success You recall accurately and gain three pieces of information or context. Success You recall accurately and gain two pieces of information or context and a piece of erroneous information, but you don't have any way to differentiate which is which. Failure You gain a piece of information or context and two pieces of erroneous information. Critical Failure You gain three pieces of erroneous information.

name: Akashic Transcendence
text: Your eye opens to greater truths. You can use Akashic Sync once per round instead of once every 10 minutes.

name: Alakablam
text: [one-action] Requirements: holding a weapon and last action was to Cast a Spell from a spell gem or spell chip. You Reload a ranged weapon using the consumed item and Overclock Gear. If the spell wasn't damaging, the weapon deals an extra 1d6 force damage and gains arcane and magical traits; if it dealt damage, the Strike deals that type instead.

name: Alarming Scream
text: You release a loud shriek meant to draw attention or raise alarm. All enemies within 60 feet must attempt a will save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC. The targets are then temporarily immune to your Alarming Scream for 24 hours. Critical Success The target is unaffected. Success The target becomes Frightened 1. Failure The target becomes Deafened for 1 round and Frightened 2. Critical Failure The target becomes deafened for 1 minute and Frightened 4.

name: Alien Presence
text: Your connection to the strange outer dragon magic within yourself grows stronger, giving you a powerful alien presence that allows you to disorient enemies more often. You can use the presence feat you have (Dazzling Presence for solar dragons, Nauseating Presence for void dragons, Slowing Presence for time dragons, Stupefying Presence for lunar dragons, or Warping Presence for vortex dragons) once per hour, instead of once per day.

name: All Hands on Deck

At the beginning of your next turn, choose which set of active hands remains your active hands. Shobhad Frequency once per day You're able to focus your coordination for a brief moment. name: All In
text: Requirements You haven't used your lucky number yet today. You can go all in on your luck in the present moment at the expense of your luck in the future. Before you roll a check, you can choose to expend both uses of your lucky number to count the roll as a 20. The effort strains your relationship with the primal forces of luck, so you don't get a lucky number tomorrow.

If the listed creature usually has a swim Speed, Ancestral Pest grants you a swim Speed of 20 feet.
